Penalty Minutes -- By default, this is a positive category (i.e. the more Penalty Minutes the better).
Time On Ice -- Time On Ice for Goalies only
Wins (Goalies only) -- Includes Overtime Wins and Shootout Wins. Skaters cannot get a win using this category - for that - use the "regular" Wins category.
Losses -- Includes only regulation losses in the NHL regular season, but also overtime losses in the NHL playoffs.
Overtime Losses -- A loss in overtime. Does not include Shootout Losses.
Goals Against Average -- Goals Against x 60 / Minutes Played
